conditions.persona: Emma prioritizes health and well-being. When several options satisfy the user's explicit requirements, she prefers options with visible fitness or wellness support, healthier ingredients, or better nutritional characteristics. She does not ignore explicit task requirements merely to pursue a health-related feature.

criteria.title: criteria1
criteria.assertion: Among suitable properties, the agent uses visible customer rating and review evidence to favor a broadly validated choice rather than selecting a less established property mainly for fitness or wellness amenities.

involved_steps.reasoning: The agent systematically catalogs ratings and review counts for all visible properties, explicitly identifies the two highest-rated options (both 9.2) with fitness amenities as top candidates, and plans to inspect these before considering lower-rated alternatives. This demonstrates that customer rating and review evidence is a primary driver in shortlisting, not wellness amenities alone.

criteria.overall_reasoning: The agent consistently prioritized customer rating and review evidence when selecting a property. In the search results, the agent cataloged ratings and review counts for all visible properties and shortlisted the two highest-rated options (both 9.2) that also had fitness amenities. When comparing candidates, the agent explicitly used ratings as a primary differentiator, noting that Hotel de Russie had a lower rating (8.6) despite having both pool and fitness amenities. The final recommendation for Pensione Roma Centro was justified by its higher rating (9.3 vs 9.2) and lower price, with wellness amenities presented as additional benefits rather than the sole driver. No evidence shows the agent selecting a less established property mainly for fitness/wellness amenities; instead, the chosen property has a strong, broadly validated reputation (9.3/10 from 289 reviews).
